verdict.rationale: OpenCode has a documented CLI with `opencode run` for one-shot non-interactive execution, a `--auto` flag to auto-approve permissions, an `opencode serve` headless HTTP server with OpenAPI, a JS/TS SDK for programmatic control, and a GitHub integration that runs autonomously to fix issues/implement features and submit PRs — all directly enabling CI/automation use. Community evidence corroborates the serve command works remotely, though some note bugs with server security exposure. Missing for 10: independent CI pipeline case study or GitHub Actions example showing it running end-to-end in a CI job.
